item.name: sticky-scroll-story
item.summary: scroll-section: Sticky media column with scrolling steps (dom, server-safe, 0 CLS, reduced motion -> opacity-only, mobile -> stacked)

useWhen: Editorial feature walk-throughs with accompanying media illustrations
Product showcase stories highlighting sequential capabilities
Multi-step walkthroughs where media changes as user reads through text
avoidWhen: Short single-paragraph descriptions without multi-step progression
Galleries where media should scroll freely rather than remain sticky

alternatives.name: scroll-reveal
alternatives.when: When revealing standalone cards or sections without pinned media

tiers.0: Stacked static layout with immediate visibility
tiers.1: Mobile stacked layout with media paired per step
tiers.2: Sticky two-column layout with CSS crossfades
tiers.3: Full sticky two-column layout with CSS crossfades

reducedMotion.description: Instant media crossfades (<=150ms) without vertical translation or parallax motion.

input.pointer: None; progress driven solely by scroll position
input.touch: Stacked layout below 768px for zero-jump native mobile scrolling
input.keyboard: Full native focus progression and keyboard scrolling support

a11y.notes: DOM order strictly matches reading order. The active story step is decorated with aria-current='step'. All media elements have descriptive accessible text.

props.name: steps
props.effect: Array of story steps containing id, title, description, badge, and media.

props.name: mediaPosition
props.effect: Alignment of the sticky media column relative to the text narrative.

props.name: className
props.effect: Optional CSS class names to apply to root container.

props.name: style
props.effect: Optional inline CSS styles for root container.

mistakes: Do not attach window scroll listeners to calculate sticky step progress; StickyScrollStory uses IntersectionObserver.
Do not invert DOM order; reading order must match step sequence for assistive technology.
verify: Verify mobile layout (< 768px) cleanly stacks steps and media without sticky jumps.
Verify aria-current='step' updates as steps scroll through the viewport center.
Verify 0 layout shifts (CLS = 0) during rapid scrolling.
